title: Your space, your rules
sub: Adjust how Inner Circle supports you. None of these choices are permanent.
languageHint: This choice applies across the whole app — every screen follows the language you pick here.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.sub: Read-only details from the demo profile stored on this device.
profile.name: Name

validation.emailInvalid: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.ageMin: You must be at least 18 years old.

profile.researchNote: You have chosen to contribute anonymised research feedback — turn it off under Consent below.
profile.passwordNote: Your password is kept only as a demo hash in this browser. It is never shown here and never sent anywhere.

consent.title: Consent
consent.sub: What you agreed to, and what you can change.
consent.termsHint: Required once when the demo profile was created.
consent.researchHint: In a real deployment this would let the university study de-identified, anonymised well-being patterns. In this prototype it only stores your choice in this browser.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.sub: Small switches for how the app behaves.
prefs.ttsHint: Your browser speaks each reply as it arrives. Everything is still written out in full.
prefs.voiceHint: Steps such as inhale, hold and exhale are spoken while you follow along.
prefs.sentimentDemo: Show simulated sentiment analysis in the companion
prefs.sentimentDemoHint: Displays a live sentiment strip for the last five messages. Labelled as simulated and only for demo/evaluation.
prefs.ttsOn: Companion replies will be read aloud.
prefs.voiceOn: Spoken guidance in breathing exercises is on.
prefs.voiceOff: Spoken guidance in breathing exercises is off.

reminders.title: Daily check-in reminder
reminders.sub: An optional, gentle nudge to note how you feel.
reminders.toggleHint: Gentle, private and completely optional — turn it off any time.
reminders.timeHint: We'll only nudge you after this time, and at most once a day.
reminders.onlyWhileOpen: This only works while Inner Circle is open in this browser. There is no push, so a closed browser means no reminder — and that is completely okay.
reminders.enableHint: Allow your browser to show the reminder outside the app window.
reminders.deniedToast: Notifications stay off. The reminder will show inside the app instead.
reminders.unsupportedToast: This browser cannot show notifications. The reminder will show inside the app instead.
reminders.notifyBody: Whenever you have a moment, a gentle check-in is here. No pressure.
reminders.toastBody: A gentle check-in for today, whenever you are ready. No pressure.

data.title: Your data & privacy
data.bulletLocal: Everything lives in this browser's local storage, under Inner Circle keys such as ic.profile and ic.moods.
data.bulletUpload: Nothing is uploaded — this prototype has no server.
data.bulletExport: Export a copy or delete it all, whenever you like.
data.exportToast: Your data was exported as a JSON file.

account.title: Account
account.signOutHint: Signing out removes the demo profile from this device. The rest of your data stays until you delete it.

footerNote: Inner Circle is a well-being and screening prototype, not medical care. It never diagnoses, never prescribes, and it is not an emergency service.

deleteModal.title: Delete all your local data?
deleteModal.intro: This removes everything below from this device only:

items.profile: Your demo profile — name, email, age and university
items.moods: Mood check-ins, journal entries and tiny wins
items.screening: Screening records and the companion conversation

deleteModal.foot: Nothing is kept on a server, so there is nothing else to clear. This cannot be undone.
